messages.subject: [FLR-list] FLR/a4a training course
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

We're organizing a course here in JRC about quantitative fisheries
management with FLR and a4a, the 25-29th August 2014. The programme is
attached and in the course's webpage (https://github.com/a4a/2014-JRC-crse).
This course is somehow complementary to the ICES courses on stock
assessment and advanced stock assessment. Our main focus is on the
computation (with FLR and a4a) and not so much on the theory, which we
expect the participants to already have.

Could you please forward to potential participants ?

Best and thanks.

EJ
